--- commonmark_parser/inlines.py
"""Inline text parsing for code spans, escapes, references, and soft breaks."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
import html.entities
import re


@dataclass
class Inline:
    """An inline text node or a soft line break."""

    type: str
    literal: str = ""
    destination: str = ""
    label: str = ""
    children: list["Inline"] | None = None


_ENTITY = re.compile(r"&(?:#[xX][0-9A-Fa-f]{1,6}|#[0-9]{1,7}|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+);")
_ASCII_PUNCTUATION = frozenset("!\"#$%&'()*+,-./:;<=>?@[\\]^_`{|}~")
_C1 = {
    0x80: 0x20AC, 0x82: 0x201A, 0x83: 0x0192, 0x84: 0x201E,
    0x85: 0x2026, 0x86: 0x2020, 0x87: 0x2021, 0x88: 0x02C6,
    0x89: 0x2030, 0x8A: 0x0160, 0x8B: 0x2039, 0x8C: 0x0152,
    0x8E: 0x017D, 0x91: 0x2018, 0x92: 0x2019, 0x93: 0x201C,
    0x94: 0x201D, 0x95: 0x2022, 0x96: 0x2013, 0x97: 0x2014,
    0x98: 0x02DC, 0x99: 0x2122, 0x9A: 0x0161, 0x9B: 0x203A,
    0x9C: 0x0153, 0x9E: 0x017E, 0x9F: 0x0178,
}


def _reference(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
    token = match.group()
    if token.startswith("&#"):
        body = token[2:-1]
        try:
            value = int(body[1:], 16) if body[:1] in "xX" else int(body, 10)
        except ValueError:
            return token
        if value == 0 or value > 0x10FFFF or 0xD800 <= value <= 0xDFFF:
            value = 0xFFFD
        else:
            value = _C1.get(value, value)
        return chr(value)
    return html.entities.html5.get(token[1:], token)


def parse_inlines(source: str, references: dict) -> list[Inline]:
    """Parse code spans, ordinary text, punctuation escapes, references, and breaks."""
    del references  # Reserved for reference-link parsing in the inline pipeline.
    nodes: list[Inline] = []
    text: list[str] = []

    def flush() -> None:
        if text:
            value = "".join(text)
            if value:
                nodes.append(Inline("text", value))
            text.clear()

    i = 0
    while i < len(source):
        char = source[i]
        if char == "`":
            run_end = i + 1
            while run_end < len(source) and source[run_end] == "`":
                run_end += 1
            run_length = run_end - i
            search = run_end
            close_start = close_end = -1
            while search < len(source):
                candidate = source.find("`", search)
                if candidate < 0:
                    break
                candidate_end = candidate + 1
                while candidate_end < len(source) and source[candidate_end] == "`":
                    candidate_end += 1
                if candidate_end - candidate == run_length:
                    close_start, close_end = candidate, candidate_end
                    break
                search = candidate_end
            if close_start >= 0:
                flush()
                literal = source[run_end:close_start].replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n").replace("\n", " ")
                if len(literal) >= 2 and literal.startswith(" ") and literal.endswith(" ") and literal.strip(" "):
                    literal = literal[1:-1]
                nodes.append(Inline("code", literal))
                i = close_end
            else:
                text.append(source[i:run_end])
                i = run_end
        elif char == "\\" and i + 1 < len(source) and source[i + 1] in _ASCII_PUNCTUATION:
            text.append(source[i + 1])
            i += 2
        elif char == "&":
            match = _ENTITY.match(source, i)
            if match:
                text.append(_reference(match))
                i = match.end()
            else:
                text.append(char)
                i += 1
        elif char == "\n":
            while text and text[-1] == " ":
                text.pop()
            flush()
            while i + 1 < len(source) and source[i + 1] == " ":
                i += 1
            nodes.append(Inline("softbreak"))
            i += 1
        else:
            text.append(char)
            i += 1
    flush()
    return _parse_emphasis(nodes)


def _parse_emphasis(nodes: list[Inline]) -> list[Inline]:
    """Resolve delimiter runs in text nodes, leaving code spans opaque."""
    result: list[Inline] = []
    for node in nodes:
        if node.type != "text":
            result.append(node)
            continue
        source = node.literal
        # Match valid flanking pairs from the inside out. The pass only handles
        # delimiter characters; punctuation and Unicode whitespace use the
        # same flanking predicates as the CommonMark delimiter rules.
        chunks: list[Inline] = []
        i = 0
        plain = 0
        while i < len(source):
            if source[i] not in "*_":
                i += 1
                continue
            end = i + 1
            while end < len(source) and source[end] == source[i]:
                end += 1
            marker, length = source[i], end - i
            before = source[i - 1] if i else "\n"
            after = source[end] if end < len(source) else "\n"
            opener = not after.isspace() and (not _punct(after) or before.isspace() or _punct(before))
            closer = not before.isspace() and (not _punct(before) or after.isspace() or _punct(after))
            if marker == "_":
                opener = opener and (not closer or _punct(before))
                closer = closer and (not opener or _punct(after))
            if not opener:
                i = end
                continue
            close = end
            found = None
            while close < len(source):
                candidate = source.find(marker, close)
                if candidate < 0:
                    break
                ce = candidate + 1
                while ce < len(source) and source[ce] == marker:
                    ce += 1
                cb = source[candidate - 1] if candidate else "\n"
                ca = source[ce] if ce < len(source) else "\n"
                can_close = not cb.isspace() and (not _punct(cb) or ca.isspace() or _punct(ca))
                if marker == "_":
                    can_close = can_close and (not (not cright and (not cleft or _punct(ca))) or _punct(ca))
                use = 2 if length >= 2 and ce - candidate >= 2 else 1
                if can_close and candidate > end and not (marker == "_" and before.isalnum() and ca.isalnum()):
                    found = (candidate, ce, use)
                    break
                close = ce
            if found is None:
                i = end
                continue
            a, b, use = found
            prefix = source[plain:i] + marker * (length - use)
            if prefix:
                chunks.append(Inline("text", prefix))
            inner = _parse_emphasis([Inline("text", source[end:a])])
            chunks.append(Inline("strong" if use == 2 else "em", children=inner))
            source = source[:i] + source[end:a] + source[b:]
            i = i + (a - end)
            plain = i
        tail = source[plain:]
        if tail:
            chunks.append(Inline("text", tail))
        result.extend(chunks or [node])
    return result


def _punct(char: str) -> bool:
    return bool(char) and (char in _ASCII_PUNCTUATION or __import__("unicodedata").category(char).startswith("P"))
--- commonmark_parser/references.py
"""Document-wide link reference definition extraction."""

import html
import re

_LABEL = re.compile(r"^ {0,3}\[([^\[\]]+)\]:[ \t]*(.*)$")


def _unescape(value: str) -> str:
    value = html.unescape(value)
    return re.sub(r"\\([!\"#$%&'()*+,\-./:;<=>?@\[\\\]^_`{|}~])", r"\1", value)


def _label(value: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(value.casefold().strip(" \t\r\n").split())


def extract_definitions(text: str, references: dict) -> str:
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    offset = 0
    while offset < len(lines):
        current = lines[offset].rstrip("\r\n")
        match = _LABEL.match(current)
        if not match or not match.group(1).strip(" \t"):
            break
        key = _label(match.group(1))
        rest = match.group(2).strip(" \t")
        destination = None
        title = None
        if rest.startswith("<"):
            end = rest.find(">")
            if end > 0 and "\n" not in rest[1:end]:
                destination, tail = rest[1:end], rest[end + 1:].strip(" \t")
            else:
                break
        else:
            dest_match = re.match(r"((?:\\.|[^\s])*)", rest)
            destination = dest_match.group(1) if dest_match else ""
            tail = rest[len(destination):].strip(" \t")
            if destination.count("(") - destination.count(")") > 0:
                break
        if not destination:
            break
        if tail:
            if tail[0] not in "\"'(" or tail[-1] != ({'"': '"', "'": "'", "(": ")"}[tail[0]]):
                break
            title = _unescape(tail[1:-1])
        references.setdefault(key, (_unescape(destination), title))
        offset += 1
        if offset < len(lines) and lines[offset].lstrip(" \t").startswith(("\"", "'", "(")) and title is None:
            candidate = lines[offset].strip(" \t\r\n")
            if len(candidate) >= 2 and candidate[0] in "\"'(" and candidate[-1] == {'"': '"', "'": "'", "(": ")"}[candidate[0]]:
                references[key] = references.get(key, (_unescape(destination), _unescape(candidate[1:-1])))
                offset += 1
    return "".join(lines[offset:])
--- commonmark_parser/autolinks.py
"""Recognition of CommonMark URI and email autolinks."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
import re


@dataclass
class InlineNode:
    type: str
    literal: str = ""
    destination: str = ""
    label: str = ""


_URI = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]{1,31}:[^ <>\x00-\x20<>]*\Z")
_EMAIL = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?)*\Z")


def parse_autolinks(source: str) -> list[InlineNode]:
    """Split valid angle-delimited autolinks from ordinary text."""
    nodes: list[InlineNode] = []
    pos = 0
    for match in re.finditer(r"<([^<>\n]*)>", source):
        body = match.group(1)
        destination = body if _URI.fullmatch(body) else "mailto:" + body if _EMAIL.fullmatch(body) else ""
        if not destination:
            continue
        if match.start() > pos:
            nodes.append(InlineNode("text", source[pos:match.start()]))
        nodes.append(InlineNode("link", destination=destination, label=body))
        pos = match.end()
    if pos < len(source):
        nodes.append(InlineNode("text", source[pos:]))
    return nodes

"""CommonMark parser integration interfaces."""

from .blocks import Document, parse_blocks
from .inlines import parse_inlines


def render(markdown: str) -> str:
    """Render a complete Markdown document to HTML.

    This foundation exposes the integration point; parsing and rendering behavior
    are supplied by later parser capabilities.
    """
    document = parse_blocks(markdown)
    for block in document.children:
        if block.kind in {"paragraph", "heading"}:
            parse_inlines(block.literal, document.references)
    return ""


__all__ = ["Document", "parse_blocks", "parse_inlines", "render"]

from commonmark_parser.autolinks import parse_autolinks
from commonmark_parser.inline_html_breaks import parse_inline_html_breaks
from commonmark_parser.inlines import parse_inlines


def test_emphasis_and_strong_nodes():
    nodes = parse_inlines("*alpha* **beta**", {})
    assert [(n.type, n.children[0].literal if n.children else n.literal) for n in nodes] == [
        ("em", "alpha"), ("text", " "), ("strong", "beta")]


def test_underscore_within_word_stays_literal():
    source = "alpha_beta_gamma"
    nodes = parse_inlines(source, {})
    assert all(n.type == "text" for n in nodes)
    assert "".join(n.literal for n in nodes) == source


def test_autolinks_uri_email_and_invalid_uri():
    uri = "https://example.test/path"
    nodes = parse_autolinks(f"<{uri}>")
    assert [(n.type, n.destination, n.label) for n in nodes] == [("link", uri, uri)]
    nodes = parse_autolinks("<person@example.test>")
    assert [(n.type, n.destination, n.label) for n in nodes] == [("link", "mailto:person@example.test", "person@example.test")]
    source = "<https://example.test/a b>"
    nodes = parse_autolinks(source)
    assert all(n.type == "text" for n in nodes)
    assert "".join(n.literal for n in nodes) == source


def test_inline_html_preserves_tag():
    tag = '<custom data-value="sample">'
    nodes = parse_inline_html_breaks(tag)
    assert [(n.type, n.literal) for n in nodes] == [("html", tag)]


def test_hard_breaks_for_spaces_and_backslash():
    for source in ("first  \nsecond", "first\\\nsecond"):
        nodes = parse_inline_html_breaks(source)
        assert sum(n.type == "hardbreak" for n in nodes) == 1
    source = "ending\\"
    nodes = parse_inline_html_breaks(source)
    assert all(n.type != "hardbreak" for n in nodes)
    assert "".join(n.literal for n in nodes if n.type == "text") == source


def test_invalid_html_remains_text():
    source = "<1not>"
    nodes = parse_inline_html_breaks(source)
    assert [(n.type, n.literal) for n in nodes] == [("text", source)]

from commonmark_parser.inlines import parse_inlines


def test_ascii_punctuation_escape_removes_marker():
    nodes = parse_inlines("\\!", {})
    assert [(node.type, node.literal) for node in nodes] == [("text", "!")]


def test_non_punctuation_escape_keeps_backslash():
    nodes = parse_inlines("\\a", {})
    assert nodes[0].literal == "\\a"


def test_named_and_numeric_references_decode():
    nodes = parse_inlines("&A😀", {})
    assert [(node.type, node.literal) for node in nodes] == [("text", "&A😀")]


def test_unknown_or_unterminated_reference_remains_text():
    nodes = parse_inlines("&notARealEntity &amp", {})
    assert nodes[0].literal == "&notARealEntity &amp"


def test_invalid_numeric_scalar_replaced():
    nodes = parse_inlines("���", {})
    assert nodes[0].literal == "\uFFFD" * 3


def test_soft_break_trims_spaces_on_both_sides():
    nodes = parse_inlines("alpha   \n  beta", {})
    assert [(node.type, node.literal) for node in nodes] == [
        ("text", "alpha"), ("softbreak", ""), ("text", "beta")
    ]


def test_empty_source_has_no_nodes():
    assert parse_inlines("", {}) == []


def test_code_span_preserves_entities_and_backslashes_literally():
    source = r"`literal & \* text`"
    nodes = parse_inlines(source, {})
    assert [(node.type, node.literal) for node in nodes] == [("code", r"literal & \* text")]


def test_code_span_normalizes_line_endings_and_removes_one_paired_space():
    nodes = parse_inlines("` alpha\r\nbeta `", {})
    assert [(node.type, node.literal) for node in nodes] == [("code", "alpha beta")]


def test_code_span_matches_only_equal_length_runs():
    nodes = parse_inlines("``a ` b``", {})
    assert [(node.type, node.literal) for node in nodes] == [("code", "a ` b")]


def test_unmatched_code_span_delimiter_remains_text():
    source = "`unclosed"
    nodes = parse_inlines(source, {})
    assert [(node.type, node.literal) for node in nodes] == [("text", source)]


def test_all_space_code_content_keeps_its_spaces():
    nodes = parse_inlines("`   `", {})
    assert [(node.type, node.literal) for node in nodes] == [("code", "   ")]


def test_code_span_splits_surrounding_text_into_ordered_nodes():
    nodes = parse_inlines("before `code` after", {})
    assert [(node.type, node.literal) for node in nodes] == [
        ("text", "before "), ("code", "code"), ("text", " after")
    ]
